ci_gate_failure_reference.failing_spec: e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts:1001 F07 entity registry > renders all 12 registry surfaces from fixture-backed list routes

pre_edit_local_reproduction.command: VITE_BFF_MODE=live VITE_BFF_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 BFF_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 VITE_BFF_FALLBACK=strict VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false npx playwright test e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts --project=chromium -g "renders all 12 registry surfaces from fixture-backed list routes"
pre_edit_local_reproduction.observed_error: Error: evolution-programs should not render a seed fallback banner — Received string included 'STRICT TYPED ERROR / strict: live adapter contract mismatch (strict mode): adapter returned no data · seed fallback blocked' and 'FALLBACK DATA'

failure_correlation.root_cause: EvolutionList (/management/evolution) fetches both GET /bff/evolution-programs and GET /bff/management/evolution-qualification (via mgmt.evolutionQualification.get -> mgmtRead -> strictLiveRead + safeAdapt(adaptEvolutionQualificationReport)). In e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts, installRegistryRoutes had no handler for /bff/management/evolution-qualification, so the request fell through to the /bff/* catch-all returning emptyListEnvelope('ancillary') with data: []. adaptEvolutionQualificationReport requires unwrap(raw) to be a non-array object and returned null, causing safeAdapt in strict live mode (VITE_BFF_MODE=live, VITE_BFF_FALLBACK=strict) to throw 'live adapter contract mismatch (strict mode): adapter returned no data' and strictLiveRead to mark global fallback/error state.

assertions_added: Original 12 registry surfaces traversal, no SERVING_MOCK_BANNER, and no CRASH_TEXT assertions preserved intact
